baseline.source: Exact delivered installer extracted and checked against its manifest.

scope: Exact point deletion without mandatory full-cloud statistics, XYZ/RGB reuploads or blocking whole-scene reload; stable viewport dimensions and visible sparse survivors; valid retained counts through edits and portable saves; independent registered analysis/mesh retention after source edits; setup-view theme consistency.

deletion_backend_comparison.measurement: Single paired warm-filesystem runs on Linux, production delete_many/apply with workspace Undo history plus atomic JSON project save, cProfile enabled in both. Synthetic ordered source data and scanner-like poor original-row AABB locality, not the user survey. Does not measure Windows, renderer, HTTP polling, network storage or billion-row data.
deletion_backend_comparison.post_benchmark_hardening: Final constant-time Undo provenance guards and masked legacy projection-count guard were added after these timings; 61 focused regressions passed. The measured source cases have no active projection.

scenarios: Exact commit, retained buffer and next selection finish while post-delete detail is deliberately withheld for 3 seconds
Rapid successive edits preserve exact source IDs, mixed scan/mesh ownership, triangle geometry, current camera, and grouped Undo/Redo; old responses cannot undo either change
Failed exact edit restores the temporary hide and preserves source masks, selection and camera
Unknown derived count preserves active cloud and analysis files; an unrelated analysis stays visible, and returning to normal view permits another exact edit before refinement
One million displayed points: exact byte-mask SHA-256 matches an independent grid oracle; next box selection works before background detail returns
Progress overlay keeps canvas dimensions stable; Stop remains pointer- and keyboard-accessible above geometry and measurement dialogs
Sparse retained GPU IDs 7/17/27 stay visibly red/green/blue during navigation; empty clouds submit no points and refined clouds regain navigation sampling
deletion_production_browser.scope: Production app/API, immutable synthetic source files, actual WebGL display and exact backend masks. Post-delete preview responses intentionally held.

large_delete.renderer: Chromium 141 software WebGL on Linux; timings are not a Windows hardware-GPU benchmark

previous_browser_timing_observations.scope: Earlier development verification runs, retained to show observed variation. These are not a controlled repeated benchmark. The complete final seven-scenario run is recorded separately in deletion_production_browser.

observations.scope: Actual production browser/API with 1M source/displayed points and 62,500 exact deleted IDs; software WebGL; previous passing frozen run also had shared Python CPU test load. Rounded values retained from parent observation of that run.
Actual production browser/API with same 1M / 62,500-point fixture; latest five main scenarios passed before the edge-fixture readiness error. Full data is retained in raw_main_report.

scenarios: No hidden overview, section or registration preview requests
Setup opens on coloured coarse perspective points while fine response is held
Refresh point detail retries a failed response without requiring camera movement
Fine response preserves measured coordinates and RGB colours
Drag automatically requests one coalesced quick/fine detail pair
Wheel reuses covering detail and automatically loads a wider view
Wider viewport automatically refreshes horizontal perspective detail
Late response from previous setup cannot overwrite current setup
Repeated selection clear performs zero point-buffer uploads
Legacy remaining count refreshes automatically without geometry requests or GPU uploads
Binary analysis equals JSON colours, avoids flattening, uploads once per recolour
Background count completion preserves the active analysis layer and GPU buffer
Late normal scan response cannot replace an active analysis overlay
Restore from analysis resumes missing fine detail after aborted load
Pending deletion stays hidden through selection clear; failure restores source display
cumulative_renderer_browser.fixture: Two synthetic four-point setups; delayed binary responses are controlled. This is not a large-cloud throughput benchmark.

progressive_preview_integration.output: Progressive preview: retry, complete-cache reuse and stale-response checks passed.

storage_and_saved_results.status: Assigned storage/snapshot implementation and all three independent backend review findings verified after corrections.

production_changes.mask_storage.py: Return exact excluded-byte count during existing immutable flat-mask copy; validate complete source mask before sparse range enumeration.
production_changes.projects.py: Only stat-valid local retained caches are bound to SHA-256 of bytes copied into a portable archive; extraction validates digests before re-anchoring local signatures. Preserves current, item Undo/Redo and active-survey edits/redo caches; drops unverified derived statistics.
production_changes.registered_cloud.py: Keep independent registered XYZ, derived survey, inspection and mesh outputs usable after original setup mask edits/removal; mark saved-snapshot provenance. Preserve conservative retirement for registration pose/source geometry changes. Undo of source masks clears snapshot changes.
production_changes.analysis_sources.py: Automatic current whole-project/bundle analysis checks actual source revisions and uses current originals when saved merged bytes no longer match original masks; explicit saved merged-cloud selection stays available.

tests.scope: Flat masks; verified portable exact/count-only metadata, active survey and Undo/Redo; prior JSON/portable storage regressions
Six existing mesh, surface, inspection and registration portable workflows
Eleven-source saved analysis/mesh preservation and existing registration/explorer deletion regressions
Independent rerun: four retained projection-count tests plus derived replacement/Undo, inconsistent legacy properties/Undo, and unproven masked derived-scalar regressions

registered_reproduction.before_fix: Deleting one original point made next inventory poll clear active_job_scan/derived. Point Undo did not restore saved analysis access; output asset bytes remained intact.
registered_reproduction.after_fix: Current automatic sources stream 43 retained points; explicit saved merge retains 44. Active derived survey, inspection result and independent mesh survive snapshot/save/reopen with unchanged SHA-256. Physical removal of one original setup also preserves these independent assets.

residual_dense_mask_cost.scope: Actual existing flat-byte-mask copy and application of known original point IDs, with a broad prior exclusion mask. Excludes XYZ selection/statistics, UI, full project save, and native Windows.
residual_dense_mask_cost.interpretation: Existing allocated flat mask spans still copy for each immutable edit. A dense billion-row prior mask can cost seconds independently of XYZ selection/statistics. These are Linux synthetic storage measurements, not Windows end-to-end deletion timings.

independent_backend_review.finding: Analysis64 replacement during a mask edit was correctly detected for after_summary, but before_summary re-anchored the old valid scalar to the replacement; Undo returned 8 when the new file had 0 finite rows.
independent_backend_review.status: Fixed and independently verified. Captured derived identity is passed to both after_summary and before_summary; replacement leaves valid_points unknown while preserving the derived file and active analysis.

independent_backend_review.finding: An inconsistent unsigned legacy exact cache was rejected during mask update, but before_properties count was overwritten with authoritative count while stale bounds remained; Undo returned minimum X=1 when actual X=3.
independent_backend_review.status: Fixed and independently verified. before_properties is discarded when its original retained count conflicts with the authoritative copied-mask count; Undo rebuilds exact bounds only on request.

independent_backend_review.finding: Pre-existing core.project_cloud return count includes masked original rows; with 10 original rows, 4 masked and only 5 finite-chainage rows, active count 5 was persisted though retained finite count was 1.
independent_backend_review.status: Fixed and independently verified. core.project_cloud counts finite retained rows using the existing mask during bounded projection, preserves every original projection row for Undo, and validates source/mask revisions. Permanent producers attach verified derived totals through record_projection; legacy masked scalars without matching proof stay unknown.

limitations: All new regression data are isolated synthetic fixtures; no user survey, native Windows installation, cold-disk loading or GPU rendering was exercised by this agent.
Flat byte-mask compatibility is retained for all existing consumers; no sparse-overlay format migration or ReFS/Linux reflink speed claim.
Portable integrity metadata verifies copied bytes and source revisions; it is not cryptographic authorship authentication.
Caches from older unverified portable/legacy metadata are discarded instead of blindly re-anchored. Exact analysis computes missing statistics when requested.
Existing stale/archived registered merges are not indiscriminately revived. Genuine registration/coordinate changes remain conservative.

General projects orphan cleanup does not decode recovery.original_data_json; explorer deletion does. This read-only audit finding was explicitly deferred by root outside the reproduced deletion issue.

final_read_only_projection_review.result: No remaining material issue found in reviewed count/mask/Undo/derived-alias changes.
confirmed: Projection count applies flags==0 while output retains n original rows.
Short source/mask rejected before opening destination; mutation during the read rejects publication.
Permanent projection producers call record_projection; temporary mesh projection does not attach a disposable derived path.
Derived identity is compared before publishing both new and Undo summaries.
Legacy masked active scalars remain unknown without revision-bound retained evidence.
Inconsistent before_properties cannot be re-signed with an authoritative new count and stale bounds.

counts_overlap: Focused Python regression counts are included in the full application test total. Installer tests and browser scenarios are separate gates; do not add overlapping focused test counts.
cumulative_behaviors_retained: Immediate usable target inclusion, numerical RMS warnings and fixed-setup registration without a separate acceptance step.
Per-link 2D/3D registration, virtual poses and no automatically allocated duplicate merged cloud.
Measured-colour progressive display, typed analysis buffers and whole-input geometry/analysis range corrections.
Explorer item/reference deletion, original-file protection, component startup checks and one installed-program registration.
limits: Synthetic inputs and Linux host validation; native Windows/WebView2/user RTX GPU execution not measured.
Warm-filesystem backend times exclude browser/HTTP/GPU; browser timings use Chromium software WebGL and are separately recorded.
Coarse source-row spatial indexes and dense previously edited flat masks retain data-dependent work; no universal instantaneous or billion-point performance guarantee.
Already archived or previously erased results cannot be restored solely by installing this update.
Actual registration pose/source-coordinate changes continue to invalidate old current-registration aliases.
No global seven-GB memory ceiling or universal real-tunnel semantic segmentation/classification/bolt accuracy claim.

installer_gates.requirement: Build from this frozen source, run staged production startup checks, test/extract completed installer, verify every extracted hash and unchanged baseline runtime, run extracted production startup check.
installer_gates.completion_record: The separate TunnelStudio_0.18.7_Release_Checks.json is generated after those completed-installer gates pass.
